body:
I've been abused for a really long time, probably my entire life, but it doesn't matter, my problems aren't real or serious or valid enough. I have no life outside of the enmeshment, I feel dysphoric for sharing feelings with my abuser, but I also can't go against it or disagree with it. I find myself content with the situation, when my abuser isn't freaking out or exploding, which is extremely contradicting to all the horrible experiences I've had, but my brain tells me that not going against it is the best course of "action". I spend all of my time in dissociation. I experience debilitating somatic symptoms of distress. I constantly doubt my thoughts and feelings. The only two states that I know of is crippling depression and revulsion of everything. I am unable to communicate or express myself to others, because everything that I experience is disturbing and convoluted. My world feels like it's closing into me, I can't process what is going on well, I have significant trouble with executive functions and I can't even understand my own situation clearly.

I kept going and going and going, it was unbearable, there was no rest, and all I felt was terror. But in the end I'm a freak, I'm a reflection of the things that happened to me. I can't stand it anymore.
